title: Choose the visual world for Olist Store
question: Dark, minimal and built for data and administration. Keep the first direction, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Real Note
options.lineage: The Brazilian real banknote family (2010 series)
options.thesis: The store's money read the way the real is printed: engraved fine lines, struck numerals, one colour per denomination.
options.viewport: Side rail and filter bar; a KPI strip of six struck numerals; the GMV trend drawn as engraved fine lines instead of a flat fill; category and state breakdowns below in denomination colours.
options.risk: The fine-line fills must stay quiet, or the dashboard reads like a currency gimmick.

raised.raise: Nothing disappears, it cancels: deactivated products stay in the table, struck through and stamped Inactive.
Category and state breakdowns share one value scale, so bars compare across panels.
Dragging a range on the trend remaps every KPI and breakdown live.
Every bar's length is the exact value; no decorative fill carries meaning.

options.label: Elenco Sleeve
options.lineage: Cesar Villela's Elenco bossa nova record covers (1960s)
options.thesis: High-contrast black and white with a red dot that marks only what changed or what you selected.
options.viewport: Black shell, oversized white KPI numerals, monochrome charts; a single red dot flags the KPI that moved most and the active filter.
options.risk: Close to the near-black plus one accent look many dark dashboards ship; it depends on typographic discipline to feel authored.

options.label: Metro Tiles
options.lineage: Microsoft Metro / Windows Phone typographic tiles
options.thesis: Flat colour tiles on black, giant lowercase headings, the accent floods whatever is live or selected.
options.viewport: Black ground, a large lowercase page title, KPIs as flat tiles that flip when the date range changes, charts in flat series colours.
options.case: Holds product clarity on a dark data screen; loses audience identification, an Olist operator has no tie to Windows Phone.
options.risk: Cropped giant type fights dense tables; easy to read as retro Windows.

options.label: Jet-age Ticket Wallet
options.thesis: Coupons that stamp their own state.
options.viewport: Each order as a coupon leg.
options.case: Loses both axes: light paper stock and a journey metaphor do not fit a dark KPI screen.
options.risk: Costume of paper on a working screen.
options.kept: Cancelled states stay visible instead of vanishing.

options.label: Botanical Folio
options.thesis: One subject at fixed scale across plates.
options.case: Loses both axes: a cream editorial world with no link to a marketplace operator.
options.risk: Editorial artifact instead of a product.

options.label: Labanotation Score
options.case: Loses both axes: a symmetric staff layout breaks dashboard scanning.
options.kept: Bar length encodes the exact value, nothing decorative.

options.label: Crouwel Grid Specimen
options.thesis: The grid is visible and is the design.
options.case: Loses both axes: poster letterforms compete with the numbers.
options.kept: Strict cell grid for the KPI strip and panels.

options.label: Variable Type Specimen
options.thesis: One slider remaps the whole page.
options.case: Loses both axes: type play is not the operator's task.
options.kept: One control, the date range, remaps every view live.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A dark zinc admin dashboard in the Linear and Vercel mould, executed with full craft.
canonCard.viewport: Sidebar, KPI cards with sparklines, an area chart, two tables.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every other dark dashboard by design.
